integrity: Proof derived by classifying terminal all-zero blocks and the one-plus-two-ones central split. Standalone independent dynamic programming, explicit cut census, coefficient and rational-moment checks; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only indexed binary words of Hamming weight three; asymptotics conditional on four-block palindromic length. Earlier eligibility/unweighted enumeration excluded from novelty; possible unindexed equivalent publication.
title: Optimal palindromic-cut multiplicities for binary three-marker words
